summary: The bill requires the Census Bureau to publish an annual public table starting in 2026 that cross-references American Community Survey responses to count and detail by state the demographics, employment, education, earnings, and poverty status of people reporting both serious hearing and vision difficulties, plus a feasibility report on expanding such data collection.
